source_note: Watchlist for Summer 2027 product-management internships. tier=must is scanned every run; additional sources every ADDITIONAL_SCAN_MINUTES. 'ats' sources use structured job-board adapters; others use legacy URL extraction. Disabled entries record companies whose careers sites could not be read, with the reason in 'note'. Every company on apmlist.com is covered: by its own entry, by a parent company's board (Mojang -> Microsoft, Splunk -> Cisco, Slack -> Salesforce, Square -> Block, Google APMM -> Google), or as a disabled entry explaining why it cannot be read.
